finding: Base faction tug: an hourly server tally of base points per faction (23 HQ entries); the winner's lead sets a crackdown difficulty scale of 1, or 2 at a lead of 64.
Base vulnerability window: an overt base is vulnerable for 3 h in every 48 h, stored as a start time and refreshed by stepping whole periods.

Wild contraband scan: one roll per planet per cycle (15 min plus up to 10 min jitter), 5 pct per eligible player, breaks after the first success; 4 min login gate; 48 h player and 3 h scanner cooldowns.

Cantina ambush: 20 pct roll on entry with an hour cooldown, harasser spawns after 15 s, timed beats, backups capped at three that leave after 300 to 360 s; targets opposite faction at level 6 or higher.
Space surprise attack: squad of 4 to 5 ships spawned 600 to 1200 units ahead of the pilot with a leader others follow and engage at once. Adapt to ground at three attackers.
Space spawn area director: total cap, per-type cap, weighted roll over groups, and a 60 s grace before the no-spawn zone drops after the spawner leaves (zone population, row 23).
Life Day seasonal window from 1 Dec with 15 fixed NPCs on six planets, a one-hour waypoint lure to one of three planet points, and one gift per player per year.
Battlefield markers: 21 zone markers on eight planets with 128 or 256 radius and a 768 no-build and no-spawn area; the loop writes a global (defect).
Newsnet headline per planet keyed to the controlling faction (win, lose, equal sets); text is in the string table, not in the box.
Event perk promoter: five perks per non-privileged player, one shuttle beacon; 17 promoter NPCs (player-run event economy, not a world beat).
Scheduled window boss: 29 boss windows from base time, period and start/end offsets with one random spawn moment per cycle; defects fixed (closed-form search, single draw per cycle, explicit anchor).

Strange aura boss event: hourly random moment, server warning, 2 to 5 minute walk, roll of 1 to 3 bosses (20/60/20), each near a random eligible player behind a 3 s placeholder; per-connection daily cap. Keep the idea; fix the single-exception death and stale-snapshot pick.

Ultimate Battle arena: five-minute warning, ten-second countdown, then four rounds with data waits of 60, 60, 20, 180 s; 5 arenas with 3 start times each. Fix the unconditional wait when the arena is empty.
Castle siege windows: 8 castles, 2 h war every 4 days, clean-up of outsiders and gates at start and end, tax reset at end; catch-up after downtime sets the next start from now.
Crack of Time: linked portal pair spawned at one of nine exits with broadcasts; the timing mixes milliseconds and 500 ms ticks (window about 198 days as written), so take only the idea.
Scheduled news line every 360 min (one message in the file) and a daily dungeon reset in a six-second window polled every five seconds.
